title: Ofakazi Ababhubhile
intro: Esikhathini eside esidlule, umphakathi wawuhlala endaweni lapho imibuso yayihlangana khona. Umprofethi wabo wababizela endleleni yeqiniso, kodwa banamathela ekungakholweni nasekucindezelweni. Le ndaba iphetha ngokujeziswa kwaphezulu. Ungakwazi yini ukubona lesi sizwe kanye nesiphetho saso ngezinkomba ezingezansi?
clues: Abantu basenqaba isixwayiso esasilethwa ngomunye wezithunywa zabo.
Isithunywa sasibizela ukuba sikhulekele u-Allah kuphela futhi saxwayisa ngenkohlakalo.
Isiphambeko sethu kwakuwukwenqaba umprofethi othunywe phakathi kwethu ngokulunga.
Sasingabaza igunya lesithunywa futhi samsola ngokukhohlisa.
Isijeziso sasisithola ngesikhathi sihlala ngokuphepha emakhaya ethu.
Sabhujiswa ngenxa yokuphika umprofethi wethu nokushushisa amakholwa.
arabic: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
verse: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption." (29:36)
